preferred_trial_profile.designation: reviewed trial starting point; not a production decision

integrated_top.available: Synthesizable single-group wrappers and a functional current-control two-P trial exist. Five leaf group types are available.
integrated_top.missing: One designated product two-P top/netlist and same-version views; top-level MC/LC identity and reset ownership.
integrated_top.conflict: Independent C/F physical fixtures both use LC ID 0; the tested joint program requires distinct IDs.

fixed_control.available: Current 64-bit MC/LC, 512-bit task/return transport, one-slot buffered return and programmable native ABI profile.
fixed_control.missing: Place and connect the current controller version, PM path and reset/deployment interlock in the same product top.
fixed_control.conflict: Upstream group generators embed the older qualified #195 LC source, not the current compact-control source.

private_s.available: P candidate exposes two 128-bit external storage clients, 10-bit word addresses, four arbiter clients and local_s_p; 16KiB contract.
private_s.missing: Product instance selection, bank/leaf views, reset and host/RX/TX/M/G client ownership must be fixed together.

intra_block_data.available: P source offers stored S replay and a 32-bit M-to-G direct endpoint; contract names hold/take ownership and descriptor route controls.
intra_block_data.missing: Select the route for each actual product P instance and bind its exact M10 endpoints, numerical format and buffering.
intra_block_data.conflict: P16 port compatibility is not proof that the two datapaths or their physical timing are identical.

cross_block_data.available: Trial transports one 128-bit word, 10-bit destination address and valid/ready to the destination private S.
cross_block_data.missing: Bind actual P0/P1 pins, reserved route, framing, single-writer ownership, buffer depth and clock domains.
cross_block_data.conflict: Nine-instance physical routing trials use boundary proxies and omit parent control; they are not the formal controller top.

cross_block_ack.available: Trial stored_link releases TX only on the destination commit handshake. Source contains no job/epoch/sequence ports.
cross_block_ack.missing: Specify physical reverse endpoint and its transaction association: explicit tags or a reviewed single-flight/flush contract; reset and CDC obligations.
cross_block_ack.conflict: Testbench identity injection does not establish identity carriage or stale-response rejection in physical production wires.

images_and_data.available: Current v2 compact images and native ABI/capacity checking; trial images and independent bundle validation available.
images_and_data.missing: Bind product image/data hashes to the final route, block IDs, ABI, topology, capacity and PM readback.
images_and_data.conflict: Upstream older controller and current compact images require explicit version review; they cannot be mixed silently.

next: Confirm a designated same-version product top with the implementation owner, then validate the seven bindings and rerun A2-A5.
